data.narrative:
Ultra Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $57M+. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public peer (277810.KQ) in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including private companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Given the nascent stage and limited availability of tightly comparable peers, the stage-progression method is the primary applicable framework. Using $57M in total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $142M. This method reflects the company's progress to date while accounting for dilution and risk at the Seed stage.

The peer-median approach is not applicable; although 11 same-sector peers exist, insufficient overlap emerges in the critical filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) to support a credible median. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $121M (low) to $164M (median) to $164M (high), with $142M as the central point. Key uncertainties include market traction since last funding, competitive positioning within the robotics stack, and path to Series A. The single-method reliance underscores the need for additional data as the company matures.
